title: 第19章 爬山第20章 治疗
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
此时的她，换上了一身浅灰色的冲锋衣，搭配一条黑色的运动裤。
脚上是一双白色的运动鞋。
冲锋衣勾勒出她挺拔的身姿，运动裤则衬得她双腿修长笔直。
整个人看起来活力满满，像个专业的模特一样。
陈阳的目光落在她身上，下腹又不受控制地热了起来，体内的真气也微微躁动。
他压下心中的异样，快步走上前去。
刘冰冰看着他，说：“陈阳，我早上的话，其实也不是针对你，只是……”
她话说到一半，没有继续说下去，转身走进了别墅。
陈阳跟在她身后走了进去。
别墅里静悄悄的。
阳光透过客厅的落地窗洒进来，在地板上投下斑驳的光影。
刘冰冰径直走到厨房，从冰箱里拿出两瓶橙汁，拧开一瓶递给陈阳，自己则拿着另一瓶，走到客厅的沙发上坐下，拧开瓶盖喝了一口。
“你知道我家为什么一直没请保姆吗？”刘冰冰放下橙汁，看着陈阳问。
“不知道。”陈阳摇了摇头，在她对面的沙发上坐下。
刘冰冰又喝了一小口橙汁，眼神飘向窗外，语气带着几分落寞：“那是因为在十多年前，我爸跟家里的一位保姆发生了地下情。”
“这件事被我妈发现后，他们就离婚了。”
“从那以后，我们家就再也没请过保姆。”
“而且我也发现，从那以后，只要有外人住在家里，哪怕是亲戚，我都会觉得很不舒服，很没有安全感。”
“所以我才会拒绝我妈，不让你住进来。”
陈阳心中泛起一阵惊讶。

他没想到刘冰冰的童年竟然经历过这样的事。
也算明白她为什么如此抗拒自己住进她家里。
他说：“冰冰，我能理解你。”
刘冰冰转过头，深深地看了陈阳一眼，似乎没想到他会这么轻易就理解自己。
她沉默了几秒，突然站起身，说：“好了，不说这件事了。”
“我现在要去爬山，你要不要陪我一起去？”
“爬山？”陈阳愣了一下，随即问，“就我们两个人吗？”
“嗯，就我们两个。”刘冰冰点了点头，“我的朋友要么没空，要么嫌爬山太累，不愿意跟我去。”
“好，那我陪你去。”陈阳笑着说，“我也好久没爬过山了，正好活动一下筋骨。”
刘冰冰脸上露出一抹难得的笑容，说：“那我们现在就出发。”
“行。”陈阳站起身，跟着她朝着门口走去。
不一会，陈阳跟着刘冰冰驱车来到江城第一大山脚下。
山脚下已有不少爬山的人，三三两两沿着石阶向上攀登。
两人停好车，沿着蜿蜒的石阶开始爬山。
石阶两旁长满了茂密的树木，阳光透过枝叶的缝隙洒下，在地上投下细碎的光影。
刘冰冰体力不错，一开始走得很轻快，冲锋衣的衣角随着步伐轻轻摆动，脸上带着些许登山的惬意。
content_en:
At this time, she put on a light gray jacket and a pair of black sweatpants.
On her feet is a pair of white sneakers.
The jacket outlines her tall figure, while the sweatpants make her legs slender and straight.
The whole person looks full of energy, like a professional model.
Chen Yang's eyes fell on her, and his lower abdomen became uncontrollably hot again, and the energy in his body was also slightly restless.
He suppressed the strange feeling in his heart and walked forward quickly.
Liu Bingbing looked at him and said, "Chen Yang, what I said this morning was actually not directed at you, but..."
In the middle of her words, she didn't continue and turned around and walked into the villa.
Chen Yang walked in behind her.
The villa was quiet.
The sun shines in through the floor-to-ceiling windows in the living room, casting mottled light and shadow on the floor.
Liu Bingbing walked straight to the kitchen, took out two bottles of orange juice from the refrigerator, unscrewed one bottle and handed it to Chen Yang. She took the other bottle, walked to the sofa in the living room and sat down, unscrewed the cap and took a sip.
"Do you know why my family hasn't hired a nanny?" Liu Bingbing put down the orange juice and looked at Chen Yang and asked.
"I don't know." Chen Yang shook his head and sat down on the sofa opposite her.
Liu Bingbing took another sip of orange juice, her eyes drifted out the window, and her tone was a bit lonely: "That's because more than ten years ago, my dad had an underground affair with a nanny at home."
"After my mother found out about this, they divorced."
"Since then, our family has never had a nanny."
"And I also found that since then, whenever there are outsiders living at home, even relatives, I will feel very uncomfortable and insecure."
"That's why I refused my mother and wouldn't let you live in."
Chen Yang felt surprised in his heart.
He didn't expect that Liu Bingbing would experience such a thing in her childhood.
It was also understandable why she was so resistant to living in her house.
He said: "Bingbing, I can understand you."
Liu Bingbing turned her head and looked at Chen Yang deeply, as if she didn't expect that he would understand her so easily.
She was silent for a few seconds, then suddenly stood up and said, "Okay, let's not talk about it anymore."
"I'm going to go hiking now, do you want to go with me?"
"Mountain climbing?" Chen Yang was stunned for a moment, then asked, "Is it just the two of us?"
"Well, it's just the two of us." Liu Bingbing nodded, "My friends either don't have time, or are too tired to climb the mountain and don't want to go with me."
"Okay, then I'll go with you." Chen Yang said with a smile, "I haven't climbed a mountain in a long time, so I just want to stretch my muscles."
A rare smile appeared on Liu Bingbing's face and she said, "Then let's set off now."
"Okay." Chen Yang stood up and followed her towards the door.
After a while, Chen Yang followed Liu Bingbing and drove to the foot of the largest mountain in Jiangcheng.
There are many climbers at the foot of the mountain, climbing up the stone steps in twos and threes.
The two parked the car and started climbing the mountain along the winding stone steps.
There are dense trees growing on both sides of the stone steps, and the sunlight shines through the gaps between the branches and leaves, casting fine light and shadow on the ground.
Liu Bingbing had good physical strength and walked briskly at first. The corners of her jacket swayed slightly with her steps, and her face showed a bit of mountain climbing comfort.
